text:
anna.docs: Hey folks — I'm doing a sweep of the Starter Lab JS/TS examples and hit an auth edge case in the token flow.
ben.eng: quick q — is this the one where the example uses process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY but the SDK now expects REDWOOD_API_TOKEN? :thinking_face:
maria.devex: Yep, that broke my local smoke test earlier. We should standardize env var names in both examples and the starter repo.
anna.docs: Exactly. Current README snippet:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```
Should be: `new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN })` per SDK v2.1.
kev.qa: Also saw the CLI auth hint still mentions `--api-key` flag. CLI 0.9 renamed it to `--token`. Small but confusing.
ben.eng: I can make a tiny PR to update the code sample + README. Want me to also change the TypeScript example in /examples/ts-starter?
maria.devex: Please. Also add a one-line note in the migration guide: "env var renamed from REDWOOD_API_KEY to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN (SDK v2.1)". Put it under "Auth changes" so people searching will find it.
anna.docs: Thanks — while you're at it, could you add a unit test snippet to the TS example that shows how to pass a stubbed token? e.g.
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: 'test-token' });
// mock network, assert right headers set
```
ben.eng: yup. I'll: 1) update JS + TS snippets, 2) fix README flags, 3) add one-line migration note, 4) add testable snippet in TS example. Opening PR in ~30m.
anna.docs: Awesome. Can you also drop a short changelog entry in docs/changelog.md? We want a searchable line for the rename.
ben.eng: will do.
pr-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-lab/pull/412 — "docs: auth token var rename + examples" by ben.eng
maria.devex: Nice, saw the PR. @kev.qa can you do a quick smoke test on CI once it lands? Check both Node 18 and 20 runners.
kev.qa: On it, I'll queue the smoke job and follow up if any flakes. ETA 2h.
anna.docs: Thanks team — once CI green, I will cut a tiny docs patch release and update the onboarding checklist to mention the env var rename. :thumbsup:
